youtube.title: Night Prayer Before Sleep | Psalm 57:1 KJV
youtube.text:
Before you sleep, hear this.

"Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast." Psalm 57:1 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 57–78, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aXGIzNACPO8

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
